$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-paths
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    export/empty/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/looped: evaluate is blocked: the lift resolve failed on the case, and testdata/export/looped.txtar, out/resolve/error.txt, records its error.
    export/looped/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the base states circular, which louder neither gives nor keeps
    export/names/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: evaluate is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: list is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: parse is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: resolve is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.

$ go test  # chain-paths
    export/empty/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/looped: evaluate is blocked: the lift resolve failed on the case, and testdata/export/looped.txtar, out/resolve/error.txt, records its error.
    export/looped/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the base states circular, which louder neither gives nor keeps
    export/names/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: evaluate is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: list is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: parse is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: resolve is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".

$ cat testdata/checks/paths.txt
export evaluate: through resolve, parse, import
export import: through no lift
export list: through import
export parse: through import
export resolve: through parse, import
script evaluate: through resolve, parse
script list: through no lift
script parse: through no lift
script resolve: through parse
